description: Main entry point for the Flutter healthcare application, initializing environment variables, setting up app state management, routing, and UI bootstrapping.

classes.name: AppInitController
classes.description: Controls the application's initialization process, managing environment variable loading, configuration resolution, and state locking during startup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Begins the application startup sequence, loading environment variables, resolving configuration, and initializing external services.

methods.name: _loadDotenvNonBlocking
methods.description: Attempts to load .env and .env.local files asynchronously with non-blocking behavior.

methods.name: _resolveSupabaseCredentials
methods.description: Resolves the SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_KEY from environment variables or dart-defines.

methods.name: _buildConfigGuidance
methods.description: Returns a string providing instructions for supplying missing configuration.

methods.name: _boolStr
methods.description: Converts boolean values to 'yes' or 'no' strings for diagnostics.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, managing initial startup, routing, and display of different UI states based on app initialization status.

methods.name: _buildRouter
methods.description: Constructs the app's route configuration with GoRouter, including access management based on auth state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, rendering boot, error, or main app based on initialization state.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous entry point initializing Flutter binding and starting the root app widget.
